title: Map Mania
description:
Map Mania
Sessions for basic PAPER map reading and compass skills.
Absolutely all welcome. You don't have to have attended previous sessions to join us. 
Meet in the car park just outside the 30 limit of Welland. ///ascendant.dislikes.throat
We will cover up to 7km very gently, likely less, as the main focus is on the map reading.
Approximately 2 hours (longer if you get us lost 😉)
If you need reading glasses, please bring them. 
Also wear appropriate layers for stop/starting.
location: Welland

title: Take Flight Support #6
description:
We shall meet at the bandstand in Priory Park for #6 of the six-week course.
We shall be starting with run/walk and progress over the weeks. Each session will have a warm-up, a running activity and a cool down taking about 40 to 50 minutes.

We should be lucky with daylight and not need torches, but please do wear hi-viz and be prepared to be seen.
